title: PAR-144 generated writer/reader BLOCK_RECORD ownership cross-check

implementation.summary: During finalizeDwgWriteStructure, compare the completed writer DwgBlockWriteResult against exact entity handles captured while emitting two paper-layout blocks, an ordinary INSERT target block, and the ModelSpace INSERT/ATTRIB/SEQEND chain. On readback, compare parsed BLOCK_RECORD fields against that ledger: AC1015 first/last entity handles; AC1024 exact owned-entity lists; both versions' INSERT references, BLOCK/ENDBLK handles, and reverse LAYOUT associations; and exactly one parsed callback per emitted record. Normalize AC1015 expected entity ordering to the legacy writer order.
implementation.evidenceLimit: This is a same-library writer/reader structural roundtrip using the reader's parsed BLOCK_RECORD fields. It is not an independent parser or hand-written bitstream decoder, and it does not qualify native CAD behavior.

remaining: Diagnose the unresolved AC1015 type-34 VIEWPORT writer/reader boundary
Add hand-written byte-level corroboration if required fields cannot be inspected through the composed reader
Exercise a non-default current paper layout through the canonical *PAPER_SPACE association
Run one exact-pinned composed independent/native qualification
